facing_contract.turn_exemption_and_flip_rule: Canonical idle faces right (+X). Owner exempts King Crab from authoring a separate perspective turn clip and allows horizontal flip (scale.x / flip_h mirror, no turn clip) to face right (+X) or left (-X).
facing_contract.left_facing_rule: Facing left (-X) mirrors horizontally (scale.x < 0 / flip_h) around foot anchor [176, 224], keeping walk phase 0..7->0 forward and mirroring ChargeFX/ProjectileFX cleanly toward -X.
facing_contract.locomotion_vector_rule: Standard bidirectional horizontal facing: pressing A/D, patrolling endpoints, or Utility AI facing an opponent behind the crab immediately rotates facing (horizontal flip without turn clip) so attack_nomal and power_up fire toward the opponent.
facing_contract.owner_note: Owner 2026-11-14 override (superseding CRAB-002 sideways lock): restored horizontal flip/rotation without requiring a turn clip so King Crab turns to face enemies behind it before firing power_up or attacking.
